desc:
🧀 Sneak past sleeping cats, steal their cheese, and race home to the mousehole before they catch you!

🐭 Ripen your cheese to unwrap rare finds and bring new mice to your crew. There are 104 to collect, including the legendary Muscle Mouse!
🏃 Train on your wheel to get faster and raid deeper, harder levels.
🌙 Every night, 2 RARE CHEESES spawn. Get there first!
